$meta.title: Reconstruction / commensurability classification
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the reconstruction thread's design state, mechanisms, prediction ledger, and open frontier. Load this first; follow detail pointers for full reasoning.
$meta.what_is_it: For dynamical/coarse observation protocols: when does pairwise coherence (EA) force realisability by a declared class (PR(R))? Commensurability = EA implies PR universally; the classification is a facet-shape taxonomy of R = conv(cell-incidence vectors), with all hardness in the constraint variety.
$meta.status: OPEN — the active successor programme (2026-07-06). Design in the capture session, verification here (Lean/audit side), writing after.
$meta.the_shape: Five certificate mechanisms, all sighted and object-backed at n<=5; syzygies are the GAUGE GROUP, not a family; multiset-domination is universally true hence contentless; the real structure is the trichotomy — k=2 tame, k=3 full-support-coordinate tame, k=3-with-variety UNIVERSAL (De Loera-Onn). All hardness lives in the variety; the successor question is a CSP-shaped dichotomy hunt, whose first transfer formulation died on the partition-vs-scope delta. Under scope contexts the picture cleaned up: acyclic structures are commensurable for EVERY language (free theorem); the language enters only through cyclic structures (recurrence); commensurability sits STRICTLY ABOVE the satisfiability-width line (C5-NAND separating object); ring parity verified clean at L=3..6. PARITY THEOREM PROVED (hand + machine-corroborated): golden-mean ring commensurable iff even; odd gap = ONE point (u=1/2, CF=1); mechanism = forest-TU + det = 1-(-1)^L; safe-topology spectrum over binary languages: {<=}: all / NAND: even / XOR: even (odd degenerate) / full: none. Winding round: coherence on a ring = circulation; vertices = simple layered cycles (winding k = k-fold cover of the observed clock). P13 MISSED informatively: aperiodicity ≠ tameness (safe(3-cycle+loop) = {3}, not 3Z; the period-4 orbit 0120 is a NON-CONSTANT necklace at L=6). NECKLACE CRITERION 100% consistent on all data: backward = theorem, forward = licensed proof target. WINDING CHARACTERIZATION now PREDICTIVE (P20: Safe(2cyc⊕3cyc)=6Z predicted fresh, computed exact); C-vertices = normalized simple cycles verified as SET IDENTITY (P17); semantics bifurcation characterized: gate-pass ⟺ closure-level (EA-on-V) and aggregation-level (circulation) coincide; gate-fail (disconnected/period-forcing languages) ⟹ they diverge and the application must declare its observation model.

headline.ring_parity: odd L=3,5 incommensurable / even L=4,6 commensurable (exact)

definitions.name: EA / PR(R) / commensurability
definitions.one_line: Protocol = family of clopen contexts (partitions of A^F); EA = pairwise coherence on common subalgebras; PR(R) = realisation by a declared class (the observer's commitment lattice); commensurability = EA implies PR(R) universally.

definitions.name: Gauge group + weight invariant
definitions.one_line: Syzygies (pointwise integer identities = hull equations + context sums) are the GAUGE to quotient by; w(facet) = min ||lambda||_inf over integer representatives mod gauge; taxonomy = weight spectrum + shape labels; certification = (integer representative, exact dual LB) pair.

definitions.name: Protocol-level vs model-level completeness
definitions.one_line: Protocol-complete: incommensurable implies SOME family member violated by SOME coherent model; model-complete: EVERY coherent-unrealisable model violates the family. Edges: protocol-complete at k=2 (the theorem) but model-incomplete. Classification needs the former; the CF diagnostic the latter. Tag every claim.

mechanisms.name: Family I: elementary chains
mechanisms.one_line: Sum of one-cell-per-context indicators <= (m-1) + target, pointwise-valid; empty-intersection lemma unifies the 3-outcome example, k=2 gadget, wrap-C4, conformality gadget into ONE parameterized Lean target. Minimal sighting n=3 k=2.

mechanisms.name: Family II: cross-context cliques
mechanisms.one_line: Clique bound Sum <= 1; bites at n=3 k=3 (cross-context triangle of singletons, half-spread witness) and at k=2 via multi-cell-per-context cliques (n=5) — chains cannot see multiple cells from one context.

mechanisms.name: Family II: odd holes
mechanisms.one_line: First NEEDED at n=5 k=3 — the pentagon in coarse-partition costume ({0|12|34},{01|2|34},{03|1|24}); nowhere at k=2 or n<=4. Design session's 5-point instinct vindicated for the odd-hole reading.

mechanisms.name: Family 0 (reclassified): affine syzygies = the gauge
mechanisms.one_line: Pointwise integer identities among overlapping cells (n=4 first sighting; 48 protocols at n=5 k=3); NOT a certificate family — the lattice to quotient by before weight is defined; linear algebra closes them.

mechanisms.name: Fourth mechanism: weight-1 exotic shapes
mechanisms.one_line: n=5 k=3, 8 instances, all half-spread: facets that gauge-reduce to weight-LB 1 but whose SHAPE (multiple negatives across contexts, e.g. B12+C13 <= 2*A1+A234) escapes chains, cliques, holes; hand-verified else_n5_verification.py. Shape, not weight, separates it.

theorems_and_anchors.name: k=2 theorem (protocol-level)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: Two coarse contexts commensurable iff every coherence block has complete bipartite cell-intersection; protocol-complete via edge certificates; MODEL-incomplete (cliques needed). HAND status — Lean ladder item.

theorems_and_anchors.name: Full-support coordinate protocols tame
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: k=3 coordinate contexts with full product support: product measure realises any coherent margins (two lines); calibration PASS at 2x2x2 (harness_v2_calibrations.py).

theorems_and_anchors.name: Multiset-domination universal (contentless)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: 0/1 polytopes: every facet has integer normal, sign-splits, constants absorb via context sums — so multiset-domination is universally true and the taxonomy's content is quantitative (weight/shape), two lines.

theorems_and_anchors.name: Majority-commitment lemma
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: A model violating an order->=2 chain has some cell above (m-1)/m >= 1/2, so chains detect only majority-committed data; spread models are Family-II-and-beyond territory. Corroborated by every ELSE witness being half-spread.

theorems_and_anchors.name: Tame theorem (interval cylinder varieties)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: C1: full-window interval protocols always commensurable (running intersection + gluing + compactness) — the tame anchor of the dichotomy; to be proved as Layer-1 licensing with C1' quarantine (finite-alphabet: the sigma-essential pathology cannot occur — [[sigma_essential_taxonomy]] witness SECURES reconstruction).

theorems_and_anchors.name: Free theorem: acyclic => commensurable for every language
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: Scope contexts + RIP conditional-product glue: support lands in V with no condition on Gamma; language silent on trees; P4' machine-PASS instance; Lean = gluing lemma + support-tracking line; compare vs Wainwright-Jordan tree-exactness.

theorems_and_anchors.name: C5-NAND: commensurability strictly above satisfiability-width
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: Golden-mean on C5: half-model scope-coherent + unrealisable (odd 2-coloring) while min-polymorphism makes BLP decide satisfiability (KOTYZ) — polytope projection is a strictly stronger power; machine-confirmed facet gap 1/4.

theorems_and_anchors.name: Parity theorem (golden-mean rings)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: C_L commensurable iff L even; C=FSTAB/R=STAB (reduction lemma, P11 exact), parity by forest-TU + det(incidence)=1-(-1)^L; odd gap = unique fractional vertex u=1/2 with CF=1 (the golden-mean PR-box); facet fingerprint 1/(L-1) matches measured gaps 1/2, 1/4.

theorems_and_anchors.name: Circulation reduction + rank gate
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: For edge-scope ring protocols passing the rank gate (EA rowspace ≡ conservation rowspace — PASS every language/L run), C = normalized circulation polytope; vertices = (1/k)·simple layered cycles (flow decomposition); R = conv(winding-1 sections).

theorems_and_anchors.name: Backward theorem: necklace ⟹ unsafe (strongly contextual)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: Per-edge sub-relations with a cycle but no winding-1 cycle force EA-coherent unrealisable uniform circulation; consistent with 100% of computed data (ρ₁₃ L=3..9, NAND all L, 974 P16 instances).

theorems_and_anchors.name: Winding characterization (safe-topology theorem)
theorems_and_anchors.one_line: Under the rank gate: L unsafe ⟺ some simple layered cycle of winding ≥ 2 ⟺ some primitive orbit wraps injectively with k=q/gcd(q,L) ≥ 2; every C∖R vertex strongly contextual (CF=1). Corroborated P17-P19; PREDICTIVE via P20 (Safe(ρ₂₀)=6Z fresh). Lemma 2 (functional digraph) = the load-bearing novelty.

structure.name: The trichotomy
structure.one_line: k=2: weight-1 protocol-complete. k=3 full-support coordinate: tame (product measure). k=3 with variety: UNIVERSAL — De Loera-Onn (every rational polytope is a face of a 3-way transportation polytope; faces = punctures), Pitowsky floor at three contexts, no finite facet taxonomy. All hardness in the variety.

structure.name: Facet-shape reframe
structure.one_line: Over V=N every valid inequality is pointwise-valid, so the classification = facet-shape taxonomy of conv(cell-incidence vectors) — Pitowsky's correlation-polytope theory specialized to partition protocols; shape primary key, weight secondary curve (small-scale polytopes near-integral).

structure.name: Safe-topology map
structure.one_line: Gamma -> {cycle structures with local = marginal}; candidate: golden-mean's safe topologies = exactly the bipartite ones. Dynamical reading: recurrence closes time into rings; golden-mean dynamics is contextual precisely on odd-period orbits.

structure.name: Closure-level vs aggregation-level coherence
structure.one_line: Gate-pass ⟺ EA-on-V = circulation object and the theorem is unconditional; gate-fail (arcs only on winding-≥2 cycles: disconnected/period-forcing languages, exhibit ρ₂₀ L=2,3,4) ⟹ the two diverge — EA-on-V commensurable everywhere tested while circulation unsafe off 6Z — and each application must declare its observation model (single-trajectory = closure; aggregated multi-run = aggregation/covering).

predictions_ledger.name: P1: ELSE empty at n<=6
predictions_ledger.one_line: Refuted TWICE: n=4 syzygies (benign — became the gauge), n=5 weight-1 exotic shapes (genuine). Both witnesses half-spread.

predictions_ledger.name: P2: minimal Family-II at 5-6 outcomes
predictions_ledger.one_line: Cliques bite at n=3 k=3; the 5-6 estimate conflated Family-II-needed with odd-hole-needed — odd-hole reading vindicated at exactly n=5 k=3.

predictions_ledger.name: P3: weighted certificates at 7-8 outcomes
predictions_ledger.one_line: Arrived at n=5 — and gauge-reduces to weight 1; with punctured-cube weight>=3 NOT confirmed at n=6, the joint diagnosis: asymptotic expectations imported below the mechanism's combinatorial room. Corrective: scale-sanity pass on every prediction.

predictions_ledger.name: 'Family I complete at k=2'
predictions_ledger.one_line: Model-level claim fails (multi-cell cliques at n=5 k=2); survives as protocol-level — the fork that forced the completeness tag.

predictions_ledger.name: P4: golden-mean + coordinate contexts commensurable
predictions_ledger.one_line: MISS — variety makes {x1=1},{x2=1} disjoint; concentrated model coherent (trivial bipartition subalgebras) and unrealisable. THE delta: partition-vs-scope; EA on bare bipartitions has no channel for the language.

predictions_ledger.name: P5: golden-mean + XOR context incommensurable
predictions_ledger.one_line: Incommensurable as predicted but via the SAME trivial exclusivity mechanism as the misses — not the polymorphism mechanism; not evidence; retest under corrected formulation.

predictions_ledger.name: P6: monotone-derived contexts commensurable
predictions_ledger.one_line: MISS uniformly (all 20 AND/OR triples): derived bipartitions freely produce disjoint cross-context cells. Same autopsy as P4.

predictions_ledger.name: Polymorphism transfer conjecture v1
predictions_ledger.one_line: 'Acyclically-reported over Gamma commensurable iff Gamma has symmetric fractional polymorphisms of all arities' — dead at the partition-vs-scope delta before realisability-vs-optimization was reached. Reformulation target: include scope contexts so EA aligns with BLP local consistency (Barto-Kozik analogy).

predictions_ledger.name: P7: C4 commensurable
predictions_ledger.one_line: C=R exact (8 facets + 8 hull eqs); the frustrated point realisable via the even 2-coloring.

predictions_ledger.name: P8: C6 commensurable
predictions_ledger.one_line: C=R exact (12 facets + 12 hull eqs, 16s); gate FIRES: parity-theorem proof attempt warranted.

predictions_ledger.name: Transfer v2 as KOTYZ
predictions_ledger.one_line: The ledger's first pre-emptive kill: refuted by hand (C5-NAND) BEFORE registration; symmetric polymorphisms give satisfiability-exactness, not polytope-exactness.

predictions_ledger.name: P9: XOR even rings safe
predictions_ledger.one_line: L=4,6 commensurable exact (V = the two colorings); odd rings degenerate (empty variety) — reported, not scored.

predictions_ledger.name: P10: implication all rings safe
predictions_ledger.one_line: L=3..6 commensurable exact (V = two constants); graded on V-induced cells (empty (0,1) not reportable) — derivation agrees.

predictions_ledger.name: P11: harness EA = FSTAB at L=5
predictions_ledger.one_line: rank(EA)=10 exactly + affine lift q(u) satisfies EA identically — the reduction lemma's common-subalgebra computation is EXACTLY what the harness computes.

predictions_ledger.name: P12: FSTAB(C5) = 11 integral + 1 fractional
predictions_ledger.one_line: Exact vertex census: 12 vertices, unique fractional = u==1/2; also 4+1 at L=3, all-integral 7/18 at L=4/6.

predictions_ledger.name: P13: ternary 3-cycle+loop Safe = 3Z
predictions_ledger.one_line: Observed Safe = {3}: L=6,9 unsafe via the period-4 orbit 0120 (non-constant necklace, 4∤6) — aperiodic dynamics still frustrates; invariant ≠ sub-digraph gcd; obstruction generators = primitive orbit periods. Harness-confirmed at L=6 (gap ½).

predictions_ledger.name: P14: NAND safe at L=8,10
predictions_ledger.one_line: Zero winding-≥2 simple cycles at all; rank gates pass.

predictions_ledger.name: P15: no NAND necklace at even L
predictions_ledger.one_line: Exhaustive 7^L search at L=4,6,8: zero; odd-L positive controls fire; rank gate = standing per-language check.

predictions_ledger.name: P16: separation hunt (|A|=3, L=3,4)
predictions_ledger.one_line: 974 uniform instances: no bad vertex with section-carrying support; every incommensurable instance strongly contextual; forward proof attempt LICENSED.

predictions_ledger.name: P17: C-vertices = normalized simple cycles
predictions_ledger.one_line: Set identity at NAND L=5 / ρ₁₃ L=4 / full L=3 / XOR L=4 (12/6/12/2).

predictions_ledger.name: P18: orbit criterion reproduces Safe(ρ₁₃)={3}
predictions_ledger.one_line: Pure combinatorics (no polytopes) matches; L=9 witness = an 18-period composite orbit.

predictions_ledger.name: P19: full-language L=4 winding-2 = anti-periodic
predictions_ledger.one_line: All 8 cycles anti-periodic; binary corollary corroborated.

predictions_ledger.name: P20: Safe(2-cycle⊕3-cycle) = 6Z (fresh forward test)
predictions_ledger.one_line: Computed {6,12} on L=2..12, exact; theorem graduates to predictive. P20b: gate fails at L=2,3,4 (disconnected language) — first exhibit of the semantics bifurcation; EA-on-V commensurable everywhere tested there.

open_frontier.name: Lean ladder for the winding theorem (NEXT)
open_frontier.one_line: Order: gate lemma, Lemma 1 (flow decomposition, special case), Lemma 2 (functional-digraph two-liner — the novelty, so ALSO the place an error would hide), mixture-support step, assembly. Then the Gross–Tucker voltage statement for the paper.

open_frontier.name: Safe-topology invariant (NEXT design turn)
open_frontier.one_line: RESOLVED 2026-07-08: the winding characterization theorem (thm.winding_characterization), predictive as of P20. Residue: covering-space (voltage) statement of the proof; the semantics bifurcation is the new structural fact.

open_frontier.name: Golden-mean parity theorem (NEXT design turn)
open_frontier.one_line: RESOLVED 2026-07-07: proved (hand) + machine-corroborated on all joints; see thm.parity_golden_mean. Lean ladder: reduction lemma, forest-TU, unique-fractional-vertex.

open_frontier.name: Q-comp: witnessed exclusivity
open_frontier.one_line: The compression programme's first-order target (bandwidth-limited observation, full joints not reportable): commensurable => every cross-context exclusive cell-pair separated by a common-subalgebra event; <=6 atlas is its evidence base.

open_frontier.name: THE successor question: the dichotomy
open_frontier.one_line: Which constraint languages (dynamics, compressions) generate tame protocol families vs universality — 'which worlds make observation tame.' Anchors: interval cylinders tame / DLO punctures universal; first open case: golden-mean SFT under the CORRECTED (scope-context) formulation.

open_frontier.name: Transfer conjecture v2 (scope contexts)
open_frontier.one_line: SUPERSEDED same-day: scope-context reformulation done; v2-as-KOTYZ pre-emptively killed (C5-NAND); live successor = safe-topology map + parity theorem.

open_frontier.name: Minimal weight-3 protocol
open_frontier.one_line: Not among 6-point punctured cubes (all Family-I, LB=1); needs larger grids for the DLO mechanism to have room; capped-weight screen at larger n is the instrument.

open_frontier.name: n=6 k=3 sweep (descoped)
open_frontier.one_line: Projected 40-160h with the exact-everything harness; rerun only if the trichotomy needs the datum, after float-prefilter optimization.

open_frontier.name: C1/C1' licensing theorems + Lean ladder
open_frontier.one_line: Prove C1 (tame theorem), C1' (quarantine), Vorob'ev-transfer check; Lean ladder: empty-intersection lemma, pentagon chain-immunity, bipartite<->edge-completeness, k=2 completeness, GYO infrastructure.

tooling.name: Exhaustive exact-rational harness
tooling.one_line: Own Fraction simplex (Bland), S_N-canonical protocol enumeration, C-vs-R separation via hull equations + exact facet enumeration, family ladder verdicts, cone-membership; calibrated on 3-outcome/RCD/nested-sanity.

tooling.name: Atlas JSONL files
tooling.one_line: commensurability_atlas_n{3,4,5}k{2,3}.jsonl + n6k2; n=5 k=3: 339 protocols, tally 92 R=C / 135 FI / 54 cliques / 2 odd-holes / 48 syzygies / 8 exotic.

tooling.name: v2 calibrations + weight-LB LP
tooling.one_line: Product-measure anchor PASS (2x2x2); punctured cubes all Family-I weight-LB 1; weight certification to move to representative+dual-LB pairs (v2.1).

tooling.name: Separation-only commensurability test (k>=4)
tooling.one_line: ring_commensurability.py: C-vs-R by hull eqs + exact facet LPs WITHOUT the family ladder (whose LPs blow up carrying the whole chain family at k>=4); C6 in 16s.
